lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred and fifty megawatts. Decay fourteen a wave. This anchor cannot be shut and cannot be left.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It can be held, though. That's different and it's worth saying out loud.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Held by what, after we leave?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: By somebody keeping the bus above the floor and the wards lit. It's not difficult work. It's continuous work.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I haven't asked you anything yet. Let's do the wave table first.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Right. Handover, then, while I've got the board in front of me. Restorers on the two inner slots, and never let both go offline in the same wave.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The relay on the high side reads the whole ingress. Don't move it. People always move it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Ward four sticks. You have to power it twice — off, three seconds, on. It'll do it every time and it isn't broken.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The lance carriage on the east slot has about eleven degrees of play. Aim it at the corner, not the lane.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Are you finished?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Nearly. Water's on the second sublevel and it's fine, whatever the survey says.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's the handover. Sixty-one people, Vasquez. It only works if one of them is standing here.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over. Bring the second restorer up — that's what it's for.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ring. Nothing else matters here.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Lift is on the pad, field lead. Two seats.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, log one volunteer to remain and hold anchor fifty-two.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Name for the log.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo, Ikenna. Lattice specialist. Civilian contractor.
lines.beat: written as a technical handover throughout — nobody says goodbye and nobody thanks anybody

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Tell them the water's fine.
